rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something oriented straight up and down or at right angles to a horizontal surface.

example.english: Keep this curtain vertical instead of letting it slant.
example.traditional: 呢條窗簾要垂直咁掛落嚟，唔好斜。
example.jyutping: ne1 tiu4 coeng1 lim2 jiu3 seoi4 zik6 gam3 gwaa3 lok6 lai4 m4 hou2 ce4

rows.note: Use this for something standing upright rather than emphasizing its geometric angle, especially in more formal or technical contexts.

example.english: Keep the stand vertical before starting the measurement.
example.traditional: 請將支架保持直立，先可以開始量度。
example.jyutping: cing2 zoeng1 zi1 gaa2 bou2 ci4 zik6 lap6 sin1 ho2 ji5 hoi1 ci2 loeng4 dok6
